decision: Retained for the repeated synthetic 20 MHz unbounded-run improvement; capture/music gains remain unproven.

loaderRefresh.initialProducerDifference: Only the later 20 MHz direct fixture is absent; its exact removal reconstructs both initial producer hashes.

virtualEvents.meaning: Fixed physical-profile software fixtures and floor-projected ideal rational references, not measured silicon. Exact event identity/order/state and absolute timestamps are compared; no first-event alignment, cumulative allowance, site model change or runtime quantization.

method.identity: oldA/oldB use one native Module object; newA/newB use another. All labels use identical options, full default trace, generated CPU bytes and ABI. Fresh instances and memories for every run.
method.compilation: CPU lowering happens once per case; the precompiled loader creates a fresh CPU Module on each construction, asserted by object identity. Construction/compilation, input setup, snapshots, hashing and checks are outside execution timers.
method.warmup: Each label receives the same number of discarded full-workload warmups in recorded Williams order (position-balanced when warmups is4 or8). Warmups are retained and checked against the same exact reference; no stable-tiering guarantee is inferred.
method.order: Williams four-label design and reversed rows; every label occupies every position equally and every directed adjacent pair occurs equally often. Runs are serial. No affinity, GC or CPU-frequency control.
method.comparison: Exact PCM bytes, all CPU/device state and diagnostics, SRAM/Flash/EEPROM/IRQ and complete host tail after every batch. No observer omission or diagnostic normalization.
method.interpretation: oldA/oldB and newA/newB are null controls. Cross-version ratio is geometric mean of the two old elapsed times divided by geometric mean of the two new times within each trial. This is coupled Node execution; it does not isolate exclusive subsystem costs or prove a C-source cause.

limits: Coupled Node execution, no exclusive subsystem duration or browser real-time claim.
Synthetic 20 MHz software oscillator profile is not measured ATtiny13A RC calibration.
Sparse native PC positions and static code shape do not establish a causal timing breakdown.
Music/capture controls include possible small losses and large host variation; retain every trial.
Virtual event fixtures validate the configured digital model, not silicon or unresolved device modes.
